projects.title: Equestriad World Tour
projects.bodyText:
- Equestriad World Tour is a thrilling horse-riding adventure where you compete in show-jumping, dressage, and cross-country events.
 - Roles:
 - Maintaining and fixing bugs of a game in production.
 - Conducted rigourous game testing, identifying and resolving and closing 50+ github tickets.
 - Updating seasonal pass/items for the game

projects.title: Jam Escape
projects.bodyText:
- JamEscape is a vibrant and addictive logic-based puzzle game that challenges players to guide buses out of gridlocked parking lots. This project was build for the gaming portal PlayzHub.
 - Roles:
 - Developed the core gameplay logic according to GDD.
 - Polished and refined controls for better gameplay experience.
 - Done unit testing.
 - Added code for PlayzHub platform analytics.

projects.title: Match It Right
projects.bodyText:
- Match it Right is a fun and colorful match-3 puzzle game where you clean up a messy house by matching three identical items. With useful boosters, limited space, and a ticking clock, it's a fast-paced challenge perfect for players 16 and up.
 - This project was build for the gaming portal PlayzHub.
 - Roles:
 - Developed the game from scratch.
 - Did all the unit tests.
 - Used addressables to reduce initial load times.

projects.title: Crazy Cops
projects.bodyText:
- Top-down car game where you have to outrun the cops.
 - I was responsible for the Car controller, Enemy AI, Tilemaps.
